A point set with a lane beyond 10x the screen or deviating >= 1e-5 relative is judged entirely under the L6 ESTIMATE of ruling (6) / R3 (b): backends.checks() (three generic rotations and the rescaled re-test, as the executor's runs evaluates them), per lane and coefficient E = 2 x (largest rotation deviation + rescaled re-test deviation) + 16u |lane| (stability.StabilityEstimate with the lane as its sector), |T - N| <= 10 max(E_N, E_T) per coefficient through backends._compare; a point whose check run a backend fails is that backend's failed point (typed reasons). The screen alone misses the masters' own rounding (DESIGN §10.4): it only selects; a set it passes has no lane beyond 10x it and none >= 1e-5 relative, which no estimate can fail (DECISIONS 2026-11-08 08:31: a lane fails only beyond 10x at >= ~1e-5 relative, or served without an estimate). NUMERICAL ZEROS (lit-val's reading of Q13 / R5, not a ruling: for the coordinator): a lane beyond 10x whose deviation is <= 10 x the carrier floor (binary64 4u, double-double 1e-24) of the point's lane scale (the largest lane coefficient at the point, both backends) counts as a numerical zero, 'pass (lax)', its point-scale deviation recorded. TRUTH (ruling (7)): a binary64 lane still failing is judged against both backends' double-double lanes at its point, consistent when they agree (differenced in double-double) to a tenth of the binary64 deviation under test; a backend off that truth by more than 10x its estimate has an estimate miss.
